lv_id , rqs_emp_id , (select name from EMP as rEmp where rEmp.emp_id = LV_RQ.rqs_emp_id ) as rqs_name , app_emp_id , (select name from EMP as aEmp where aEmp.emp_id = LV_RQ.app_emp_id ) as app_name , start_date , end_date , status , request_date , lv_ty , (SELECT lv_ty_de FROM LV_RQ_CD WHERE lv_ty = LV_RQ.lv_ty) AS leave_type_name , reg_ip , reg_date , reg_us_id , mod_ip , mod_date , mod_us_id , use_yn , note FROM LV_RQ WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LV_RQ ( lv_ty , app_emp_id , rqs_emp_id , start_date , end_date , status , request_date , reg_ip , reg_date , reg_us_id , mod_ip , mod_date , mod_us_id , use_yn , note ) VALUES ( #{leaveTypeCode}, #{appEmpId}, #{rqsEmpId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{requestDate}, #{regIp}, #{regDate}, #{regUsId}, #{modIp}, #{modDate}, #{modUsId}, #{useYn}, #{note} )
mapper.update: UPDATE LV_RQ SET lv_ty = #{leaveTypeCode}, app_emp_id = #{appEmpId}, rqs_emp_id = #{rqsEmpId}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, status = #{status}, request_date = #{requestDate}, mod_ip = #{modIp}, mod_date = #{modDate}, mod_us_id = #{modUsId}, use_yn = #{useYn}, note = #{note} WHERE lv_id = #{lvId}
